narr: A cluster of strong to severe thunderstorms rolled through much of southeast Arizona resulting in flash flooding including swift water rescues and damaging winds.
ev: Numerous reports of flash flooding across the Tucson Metro. ||Reports included the following: |1) Water Rescue near Silverlake and Euclid Ave.|2) Swift water rescue on Bilby and Fontana with motorist stranded on roof of car.|3) Public reported flooding in the street near Grant and Dodge Road. Flooding above the sidewalk and public transit bus struggled to drive through the street.|4) Multiple swift water rescues in Central Tucson.
Road flooding on Sahuarita Road east of Comsoft Drive.
Reports of flash flooding northeast side of Tucson included the following:|1) Tanque Verde Loop Road south of Linden Street at the Tanque Verde Creek.|2) Redington Road near Canyon del Salto Wash.
